description: This file defines the MyAccountsDashlet class, which extends the DashletGeneric class to create a custom dashboard widget (dashlet) for 'My Accounts' in SuiteCRM. It includes constructor initialization, configuration of search fields and columns, and a process method with custom logic for handling email addresses and parent account names.

classes.name: MyAccountsDashlet
classes.description: A custom dashlet for displaying user's Accounts with enhanced email handling and parent account reference.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet with title, search fields, columns, and seed bean for Accounts.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Overrides the parent process method to include custom selection and join logic for email addresses and parent account names.
